entities.name: Scientific Revolution
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: A period of major scientific transformation in Europe from roughly 1543 to 1687, with discoveries by Copernicus, Galileo, Kepler, and Newton fundamentally changing understanding of the natural world. Established the modern scientific method and institutions like the Royal Society.

entities.name: Scientific Revolution
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The transformation in European thought (c. 1543–1687) that replaced medieval Aristotelian natural philosophy with modern science. From Copernicus's heliocentrism through Newton's Principia, it established the scientific method, rational inquiry, and the mechanistic worldview.
